name: Sunrise Dental Studio
address: Shop 4, Example Arcade, Andheri West, Mumbai 400058

doctors.name: Dr. Meera Kulkarni
doctors.bio: Dr. Meera has treated families in Andheri for over ten years. Patients know her for explaining every option — and its cost — before starting any treatment.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Dr. Meera explained everything before starting my root canal. Much less scary than I expected, and the clinic is spotless.

reviews.author: Rahul M.
reviews.text: Got an appointment the same evening for a broken tooth. Quick, clean and very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Anita D.
reviews.text: My son was terrified of dentists. The team was so patient with him — he actually wants to go back now.

notes.title: Calls go unanswered during the 2–5 pm break
notes.detail: Patients who call then simply try the next clinic. A WhatsApp booking button and an away message catch them instead.
